data.long_meaning: The name Benji is derived from the Hebrew name Benjamin, meaning 'son of the south'. In the Bible, Benjamin is the twelfth and youngest son of Jacob. This name is rich in meaning and symbolism, representing both strength and kindness. The name Benji carries the meaning “Son of the south” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Benji usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the south and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: בניג'
in_hebrew.meaning: בנו של ימין, בן הימין, בן ימיני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בניג' הוא צורה מקוצרת של בנימין, שפירושו בנו של ימין או בן הימין. השם בנימין ניתן לבנו הצעיר של יעקב ואשתו רחל, ונולד לאחר מות אחותו רחל. השם מתאר את מעמדו של בנימין כבן האהוב והנערץ.

in_greek.name: Μπεντζί
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπεντζί είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Βενιαμίν, που σημαίνει ο υιός του δεξιού χεριού ή ο υιός της δεξιάς πλευράς. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Βενιαμίν αναφέρεται στο Βιβλίο των Πράξεων ως ένας από τους γιους του Ιακώβ.

in_latin.name: Benji
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Benji est forma diminutiva nominis Benedictus, quod significat filius dextrae manus. Nomen hoc habet origines hebraicas et ad traditionem christianam pertinet, quia benedictio et manus dextra significant prosperitatem et gratiam.

in_english.name: Benji
in_english.meaning: Son of the right hand, beloved son
in_english.long_meaning: The name Benji is a diminutive form of Benjamin, which originates from the Hebrew name Binyamin, meaning 'son of the right hand' or 'beloved son'. In the Bible, Benjamin was the youngest son of Jacob and Rachel, and his name symbolizes his status as a favored and cherished child. The name has been used in Christian tradition to signify a child born on the right hand or a child of good fortune.

Despite this association, the name Benjamin retains its cultural significance as a strong and evocative moniker with biblical origins.
data.spiritual_significance: For many Christians, the name Benjamin holds a special spiritual significance. The name is a reminder of the biblical story of Jacob and his twelve sons, with Benjamin being the youngest and most beloved. As a son of Jacob, Benjamin represents the promises and blessings passed down through generations. The name also embodies the qualities of kindness and strength, making it a meaningful choice for those seeking a name that reflects their faith and values.
